name: The Ensorcelled Parchment
summary: A spell on a parchment makes its writing unreadable, apart from one word at the top: Nagaz. You are to take it to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.

sections.title: A Spell-Veiled Parchment
sections.body: A spell lies on the parchment and keeps its writing from being deciphered. Only a single word at the top can be made out, the name Nagaz. You are to take it to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.

sections.title: What Dibbs Makes of It
sections.body: Dibbs asks whether this is yet more encrypted notes. Dibbs wishes every odd scrap of writing drifting out of Alterac could be decoded, but admits to lacking the knowledge.

faq.q: What is written on the parchment?
aliases: what does the ensorcelled parchment say
faq.answer: A spell keeps the writing from being read, save for a single word at the top: Nagaz.
Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore, who takes in scraps of lore gathered from the mountains.
